verdict.rationale: The docs say inboxes are created, managed and operated entirely via API. There is an API reference with an SDK, and a probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.agentmail.to/openapi.json. The documented surface covers inboxes, messages, threads, webhooks, scoped API keys and permissions, and agents can self-register to obtain an API key. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the API working as documented (the community evidence is mostly about the website and pricing).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
